minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  January 31, 2018

A special meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, February
14, 2019, at 2:09 pm in the City Council Community Room A, 1st Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Serena Martinez, Finance Department

  Also present:  Jerry Tucker, Code Enforcement Manager

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for Marie Kirk; dba: JMK Consultants, LLC to conduct background
  investigation for the City of Inglewood, subject to annual payment of
  business license and tax fees; adhere to all applicable IMC regulations,
  including noise, signage, local, state and federal laws. Motion carried
  unanimously. (Activity No. 00273451)

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the tobacco retailer
  license request Adiam Kasmai; dba: Pure Sky Lounge to operate as a
  tobacco retailer and hookah lounge at 630 N. La Brea Ave., Unit 105,
  subject to sales of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco,
  hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly
  prohibited; persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products
  shall have valid identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products;
  “NO LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING”
  signage must be posted outside of the business; sales of marijuana and
  cannabis products, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of
  pipe used to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine,
  methamphetamine, including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped
  pipes used to smoke and/or ingest narcotics; sales or display of any type
  of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is
  strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new
  applicants or their designees is subject to random Permits & Licensing
  establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police and
 Permits & License Committee  January 31, 2019

  Code Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is to enforce
  business establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood and Community Public Health & Safety; parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes, live bands/music,
  disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business owner(s) is required
  to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all applicable IMC rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage.  for Motion carried
  unanimously. (Activity No. 00249495)

  Present: Adiam Kasmai, Owner, Pure Sky Lounge

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:29 pm.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
